$comment: Standard 830-point solderless breadboard. Each row has two 5-hole strips (a-e, f-j) separated by the center channel. Rails run the full length (set splitRails=true for boards whose rails break in the middle).
name: 830-point breadboard

picoPlacement.$comment: Pico straddles the channel with USB toward row 1. Pins 1-20 in column c (rows 1-20), pins 40-21 in column h (rows 1-20). The PCB covers columns d-g on rows 1-20, so only a-b and i-j are free for jumpers (listed in preference order: outermost first).
